Andrej Kramaric.note: Kramarić gives Croatia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Andrej Kramaric.noteZh: 他是Croatia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Ante Budimir.note: Budimir has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Panama. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Ante Budimir.noteZh: 他已经为Croatia进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Dominik Kotarski.note: Kotarski is Croatia's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Dominik Kotarski.noteZh: 他是Croatia的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Dominik Livakovic.note: Livaković has carried the keeper minutes for Croatia. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Dominik Livakovic.noteZh: 他是Croatia防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Duje Caleta-Car.note: Ćaleta-Car gives Croatia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Duje Caleta-Car.noteZh: 他是Croatia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Igor Matanovic.note: Matanović gives Croatia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Igor Matanovic.noteZh: 他是Croatia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Ivan Perisic.note: Perišić has both scored and created for Croatia in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Ivan Perisic.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Croatia贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Ivor Pandur.note: Pandur sits behind the starter for Croatia, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Ivor Pandur.noteZh: 他给Croatia保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Josip Stanisic.note: Stanišić has supplied one of Croatia's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Josip Stanisic.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Croatia创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Josip Sutalo.note: Šutalo has been part of Croatia's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Josip Sutalo.noteZh: 他给Croatia后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Josko Gvardiol.note: Gvardiol is defensive rotation for Croatia. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Josko Gvardiol.noteZh: 他是Croatia艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Kristijan Jakic.note: Jakić gives Croatia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Kristijan Jakic.noteZh: 他是Croatia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Luka Modric.note: Modrić has one tournament assist in the bank for Croatia. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Luka Modric.noteZh: 他已经帮Croatia制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Luka Sucic.note: Sučić gives Croatia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Luka Sucic.noteZh: 他是Croatia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Luka Vuskovic.note: Vušković is defensive cover for Croatia's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Luka Vuskovic.noteZh: 他是Croatia在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Marco Pasalic.note: Pašalić is an attacking change-up for Croatia. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Marco Pasalic.noteZh: 他是Croatia的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Marin Pongracic.note: Pongračić has been part of Croatia's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Marin Pongracic.noteZh: 他给Croatia后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Mario Pasalic.note: Pašalić is midfield insurance for Croatia. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Mario Pasalic.noteZh: 他给Croatia一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Martin Baturina.note: Baturina's World Cup has already included a goal against England. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Martin Baturina.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Martin Erlic.note: Erlić is the kind of defender Croatia can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Martin Erlic.noteZh: 他是Croatia艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Mateo Kovacic.note: Kovačić has already created a goal for Croatia in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Mateo Kovacic.noteZh: 他已经参与了Croatia的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Nikola Moro.note: Moro is midfield insurance for Croatia. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Nikola Moro.noteZh: 他给Croatia一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Nikola Vlasic.note: Vlašić already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Ghana. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Nikola Vlasic.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Petar Musa.note: Musa already has a World Cup goal in this run, against England. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Petar Musa.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Petar Sucic.note: Sučić has both scored and created for Croatia in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Petar Sucic.noteZh: 他在这段征程中既进球也创造机会。同一次跑动，可能变成射门，也可能变成射门前的一脚传球。

Toni Fruk.note: Fruk gives Croatia midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Toni Fruk.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Croatia来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。
